description: Write: brain housekeeping — recalculate heat, prune weak synapses, check integrity, rebuild the search index. Returns a report (counts, integrity_issues, repairable, notes) and flags debts without a revisit trigger. dry_run:true writes nothing. Extras run only when asked: archive cold neurons (they stop being searchable), unarchive, purge_boilerplate, repair, backfill_dates, compact. Session close is crbro_consolidate; reading the brain is crbro_inspect.

archive.description: Move cold neurons (heat < 0.05, untouched 90+ days) to archives/, out of search. Dry-run first (archivable_ids); undo with unarchive.

backfill_dates.description: Date pre-1.13 entries from a day stated in their own text; nothing is guessed (dates_backfilled).

compact.description: Fold one-line neurons from a bulk import (compact_groups) into one digest per group; sources copied to quarantine first, shared neurons untouched. Dry-run first.

dry_run.description: Report only: nothing is written. Counts, debts and integrity checks still run.

purge_boilerplate.description: Delete contentless facts the miner left (counted in every report); a quarantine copy is kept.

repair.description: Fix what the integrity check found (dangling links, orphan synapses, stale keys, counters); lists repairs[].

stale_list.description: Read-only: page through every stale entry, most overdue first (default limit 50). Runs alone.

stale_review.description: Act on many stale entries: verify (still true; its clock restarts) or retire them (superseded / retracted). Takes the pairs stale_list returns; runs alone, not with dry_run.

unarchive.description: Neuron ids (or "all") to bring back from archives/ and reindex.

name: crbro_maintenance
title: Brain maintenance
